newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates Bank launches new UAE stock index.
newsitem.headline: Emirates Bank launches new UAE stock index.

text.p: Dubai-based Emirates Bank International on Monday launched an index of shares on the informal United Arab Emirates stock market.
The Emirates Equity Index, EMNEX, will monitor 31 shares, EBI chief executive Anis al-Jallaf told a news conference.
For years the UAE has been working at setting up an official market, which bankers now expect to be established this year.
Currently there is one other unofficial index -- that calculated by the National Bank of Abu Dhabi.
Jallaf said EBI would also give separate indices for the banking, services and insurance sectors.
"The total market value of UAE equities is estimated to be 64 billion dirhams, with 49 percent in banking stocks, 44 percent in services and seven percent in insurance stocks," Jallaf said.
EMNEX has a base of 1,000 points on January 1, 1996.
